items.question: Trong câu "A practitioner who lacks one is forced to invent an approach based on whatever seems reasonable at the moment — and ad hoc methods rarely yield great results.", từ "practitioner" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A practitioner who lacks one is forced to invent an approach based on whatever seems reasonable at the moment — and ad hoc methods rarely yield great results.", what does "practitioner" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who works in a profession
items.explanation: practitioner /prækˈtɪʃ.ən.ər/ (danh từ): người hành nghề. "A software practitioner" = người làm nghề phần mềm thực tế, đối lập với người chỉ nghiên cứu lý thuyết.
items.explanationEn: practitioner /prækˈtɪʃ.ən.ər/ (noun): a person who works in a profession. "A software practitioner" is someone who actually does the work, as opposed to someone who only studies it.

items.question: Trong câu "A practitioner who lacks one is forced to invent an approach based on whatever seems reasonable at the moment — and ad hoc methods rarely yield great results.", từ "ad hoc" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A practitioner who lacks one is forced to invent an approach based on whatever seems reasonable at the moment — and ad hoc methods rarely yield great results.", what does "ad hoc" (adjective) mean?
options: tùy hứng, không theo kế hoạch
được tự động hóa hoàn toàn
optionsEn: made up on the spot, unplanned
items.explanation: ad hoc /ˌæd ˈhɒk/ (tính từ): tùy hứng, không theo kế hoạch. "Ad hoc methods" = cách làm chắp vá, nghĩ ra tại chỗ; thường đối lập với "systematic" (có hệ thống).
items.explanationEn: ad hoc /ˌæd ˈhɒk/ (adjective): made up on the spot, unplanned. "Ad hoc methods" are improvised on the spot; the usual opposite is "systematic".

items.question: Trong câu "A practitioner who lacks one is forced to invent an approach based on whatever seems reasonable at the moment — and ad hoc methods rarely yield great results.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A practitioner who lacks one is forced to invent an approach based on whatever seems reasonable at the moment — and ad hoc methods rarely yield great results.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to produce or give a result
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): mang lại, tạo ra. "Yield results/benefits" = mang lại kết quả/lợi ích; nghĩa khác "yield to" là nhượng bộ.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce or give a result. "Yield results/benefits" means to produce them; "yield to" has the different sense of giving in.

items.question: Trong câu "Equally, do not cling to a packaged methodology and follow the same script in every situation.", từ "cling to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Equally, do not cling to a packaged methodology and follow the same script in every situation.", what does "cling to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: cling to /klɪŋ tuː/ (cụm từ): bám chặt lấy. "Cling to an idea/method" = khư khư giữ một ý tưởng hay phương pháp dù nó không còn phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: cling to /klɪŋ tuː/ (phrase): to hold on to tightly. "Cling to an idea/method" means refusing to let go of it even when it no longer fits.

items.question: Trong câu "Its four activities are interwoven, incremental, and iterative:", từ "interwoven" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Its four activities are interwoven, incremental, and iterative:", what does "interwoven" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: interwoven /ˌɪn.təˈwəʊ.vən/ (tính từ): đan xen vào nhau. Gốc từ "interweave" (dệt đan vào nhau); "closely interwoven" = gắn bó chặt chẽ, khó tách rời.
items.explanationEn: interwoven /ˌɪn.təˈwəʊ.vən/ (adjective): closely mixed together. From "interweave"; "closely interwoven" describes things so connected they are hard to separate.

items.question: Trong câu "Its four activities are interwoven, incremental, and iterative:", từ "iterative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Its four activities are interwoven, incremental, and iterative:", what does "iterative" (adjective) mean?
options: lặp đi lặp lại theo vòng
items.explanation: iterative /ˈɪt.ər.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): lặp đi lặp lại theo vòng. "An iterative process" = quy trình làm theo nhiều vòng, mỗi vòng cải tiến kết quả của vòng trước.
items.explanationEn: iterative /ˈɪt.ər.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): repeated in cycles. "An iterative process" works in repeated cycles, each improving on the previous one.

items.question: Trong câu "You process that information to understand it, classify it, and relate customer needs to possible requirements (analysis) — which may make you realise you need to elicit more.", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You process that information to understand it, classify it, and relate customer needs to possible requirements (analysis) — which may make you realise you need to elicit more.", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khơi gợi, thu thập (thông tin). "Elicit requirements/information" = khai thác yêu cầu từ người dùng; danh từ: elicitation.
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out information. "Elicit requirements/information" means drawing them out of people; noun: elicitation.

items.question: Trong câu "The key operating phrase is progressive refinement of detail — moving from initial concepts of what is needed toward further precision of understanding and expression.", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key operating phrase is progressive refinement of detail — moving from initial concepts of what is needed toward further precision of understanding and expression.", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
options: sự tinh chỉnh, làm rõ dần
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): sự tinh chỉnh, làm rõ dần. "Progressive refinement" = làm rõ dần từng bước; động từ "refine" (tinh chỉnh).
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (noun): gradual improvement in detail. "Progressive refinement" means improving detail step by step; verb: "refine".

items.question: Trong câu "The key operating phrase is progressive refinement of detail — moving from initial concepts of what is needed toward further precision of understanding and expression.", từ "precision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key operating phrase is progressive refinement of detail — moving from initial concepts of what is needed toward further precision of understanding and expression.", what does "precision" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (danh từ): độ chính xác. Tính từ "precise" (chính xác); developers cần yêu cầu "with precision" để lập trình đúng.
items.explanationEn: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (noun): exactness. Adjective: "precise"; developers need requirements stated "with precision" to build them correctly.

items.question: Trong câu "But often they are not unreasonable — they are simply uninformed.", từ "uninformed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But often they are not unreasonable — they are simply uninformed.", what does "uninformed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uninformed /ˌʌn.ɪnˈfɔːmd/ (tính từ): thiếu thông tin. "Uninformed" = chưa được cung cấp đủ thông tin; cách khắc phục là giải thích lý do (inform them).
items.explanationEn: uninformed /ˌʌn.ɪnˈfɔːmd/ (adjective): lacking information. "Uninformed" means not given enough information; the cure is to explain your reasons.

items.question: Trong câu "The vision gives everyone a common understanding of the outcome; the scope draws the boundary between what is in and out for a release.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The vision gives everyone a common understanding of the outcome; the scope draws the boundary between what is in and out for a release.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "Draw the boundary between A and B" = vạch ranh giới giữa A và B; scope xác định cái gì trong/ngoài phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a dividing line. "Draw the boundary between A and B" means marking where one ends and the other begins.

items.question: Trong câu "Groups may differ in frequency of use, features used, privilege levels, or experience.", từ "privilege" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Groups may differ in frequency of use, features used, privilege levels, or experience.", what does "privilege" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): quyền hạn (truy cập). "Privilege levels" = cấp quyền (vd. admin vs. người dùng thường); nghĩa khác: đặc ân, vinh dự.
items.explanationEn: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (noun): a level of access rights. "Privilege levels" are levels of access rights (e.g. admin vs. regular user); another sense is an honour.

items.question: Trong câu "makes decisions on its behalf", từ "on behalf of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "makes decisions on its behalf", what does "on behalf of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on behalf of /ɒn bɪˈhɑːf əv/ (cụm từ): thay mặt cho. "On its behalf" = "on behalf of it" = thay mặt nhóm người dùng đó để ra quyết định.
items.explanationEn: on behalf of /ɒn bɪˈhɑːf əv/ (phrase): representing, acting for. "On its behalf" means acting as the representative of that user class.

items.question: Trong câu "Especially valuable for commercial products with a large, diverse customer base.", từ "diverse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Especially valuable for commercial products with a large, diverse customer base.", what does "diverse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: diverse /daɪˈvɜːs/ (tính từ): đa dạng. "A diverse customer base" = tập khách hàng đa dạng về nhu cầu và đặc điểm; danh từ: diversity.
items.explanationEn: diverse /daɪˈvɜːs/ (adjective): varied, of many kinds. "A diverse customer base" includes customers with many different needs; noun: diversity.

items.question: Trong câu "Unlike product champions, focus groups generally do not have decision-making authority.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unlike product champions, focus groups generally do not have decision-making authority.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): quyền hạn. "Decision-making authority" = quyền ra quyết định; "the authorities" (số nhiều) là cơ quan chức năng.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): the power to decide. "Decision-making authority" is the power to decide; "the authorities" means official bodies.

items.question: Trong câu "Three classes: signal events (control signals or data from external devices), temporal events (time-triggered), and business events (a user action that triggers a use case).", từ "temporal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three classes: signal events (control signals or data from external devices), temporal events (time-triggered), and business events (a user action that triggers a use case).", what does "temporal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: temporal /ˈtem.pər.əl/ (tính từ): liên quan đến thời gian. "Temporal events" = sự kiện kích hoạt theo thời gian (vd. chạy báo cáo lúc nửa đêm). Đừng nhầm với "temporary".
items.explanationEn: temporal /ˈtem.pər.əl/ (adjective): related to time. "Temporal events" are triggered by time (e.g. a midnight report). Do not confuse with "temporary".

items.question: Trong câu "Security requirements, regulatory compliance requirements, glossaries, data models, and user class descriptions all reuse well.", từ "regulatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security requirements, regulatory compliance requirements, glossaries, data models, and user class descriptions all reuse well.", what does "regulatory" (adjective) mean?
options: thuộc chuẩn kỹ thuật nội bộ
items.explanation: regulatory /ˈreɡ.jə.lə.tər.i/ (tính từ): thuộc quy định pháp lý. "Regulatory compliance" = tuân thủ các quy định của cơ quan quản lý; danh từ: regulation.
items.explanationEn: regulatory /ˈreɡ.jə.lə.tər.i/ (adjective): relating to official rules. "Regulatory compliance" means obeying rules set by official bodies; noun: regulation.

items.question: Trong câu "Analysis refines requirements so all stakeholders understand them, and scrutinises them for errors, omissions, and other deficiencies.", từ "scrutinise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysis refines requirements so all stakeholders understand them, and scrutinises them for errors, omissions, and other deficiencies.", what does "scrutinise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: scrutinise /ˈskruː.tɪ.naɪz/ (động từ): xem xét kỹ lưỡng. "Scrutinise something for errors" = soi kỹ để tìm lỗi; danh từ: scrutiny. Cách viết Mỹ: scrutinize.
items.explanationEn: scrutinise /ˈskruː.tɪ.naɪz/ (verb): to examine closely. "Scrutinise something for errors" means examining it carefully; noun: scrutiny. US spelling: scrutinize.

items.question: Trong câu "Analysis refines requirements so all stakeholders understand them, and scrutinises them for errors, omissions, and other deficiencies.", từ "omission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysis refines requirements so all stakeholders understand them, and scrutinises them for errors, omissions, and other deficiencies.", what does "omission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: omission /əˈmɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): sự bỏ sót. Động từ "omit" (bỏ sót); "errors and omissions" là cụm hay gặp khi rà soát tài liệu.
items.explanationEn: omission /əˈmɪʃ.ən/ (noun): something left out. Verb: "omit"; "errors and omissions" is a common pairing when reviewing documents.

items.question: Trong câu "Analysis refines requirements so all stakeholders understand them, and scrutinises them for errors, omissions, and other deficiencies.", từ "deficiency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysis refines requirements so all stakeholders understand them, and scrutinises them for errors, omissions, and other deficiencies.", what does "deficiency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deficiency /dɪˈfɪʃ.ən.si/ (danh từ): sự thiếu sót, khiếm khuyết. "Deficiencies in requirements" = các khiếm khuyết của yêu cầu; nghĩa y khoa: thiếu chất (vitamin deficiency).
items.explanationEn: deficiency /dɪˈfɪʃ.ən.si/ (noun): a flaw or shortcoming. "Deficiencies in requirements" are flaws; in medicine it means lacking a nutrient (vitamin deficiency).

items.question: Trong câu "A prototype makes concepts tangible and helps developers and users reach a mutual understanding of the problem.", từ "tangible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A prototype makes concepts tangible and helps developers and users reach a mutual understanding of the problem.", what does "tangible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tangible /ˈtæn.dʒə.bəl/ (tính từ): cụ thể, hữu hình. "Make concepts tangible" = biến ý tưởng thành thứ nhìn thấy, chạm vào được; trái nghĩa: intangible.
items.explanationEn: tangible /ˈtæn.dʒə.bəl/ (adjective): concrete, real enough to grasp. "Make concepts tangible" means turning ideas into something people can see and try; opposite: intangible.

items.question: Trong câu "A prototype makes concepts tangible and helps developers and users reach a mutual understanding of the problem.", từ "mutual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A prototype makes concepts tangible and helps developers and users reach a mutual understanding of the problem.", what does "mutual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mutual /ˈmjuː.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): chung, của cả hai bên. "Reach a mutual understanding" = đạt được sự hiểu biết chung giữa các bên.
items.explanationEn: mutual /ˈmjuː.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): shared by both sides. "Reach a mutual understanding" means both sides come to share the same understanding.

items.question: Trong câu "Analyze requirement feasibility.", từ "feasibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analyze requirement feasibility.", what does "feasibility" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: how practical something is to do
items.explanation: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính khả thi. "Feasibility study" = nghiên cứu khả thi; tính từ "feasible" (khả thi).
items.explanationEn: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): how practical something is to do. "Feasibility study" is a common collocation; adjective: "feasible".

items.question: Trong câu "Diagrams reveal incorrect, inconsistent, missing, and superfluous requirements that prose hides.", từ "superfluous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Diagrams reveal incorrect, inconsistent, missing, and superfluous requirements that prose hides.", what does "superfluous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: superfluous /suːˈpɜː.flu.əs/ (tính từ): thừa, không cần thiết. "Superfluous requirements" = yêu cầu thừa, không phục vụ mục tiêu nào; từ gần nghĩa: redundant.
items.explanationEn: superfluous /suːˈpɜː.flu.əs/ (adjective): unnecessary, extra. "Superfluous requirements" serve no real purpose; a close synonym is "redundant".

items.question: Trong câu "Allocate requirements to subsystems for complex products containing multiple software, hardware, and human components.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Allocate requirements to subsystems for complex products containing multiple software, hardware, and human components.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ, gán cho. "Allocate X to Y" = phân bổ X cho Y; danh từ: allocation (vd. memory allocation).
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to assign to. "Allocate X to Y" means assigning X to Y; noun: allocation (e.g. memory allocation).

items.question: Trong câu "Uniquely label each requirement, using a convention robust enough to withstand additions, deletions, and moves over time.", từ "robust" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Uniquely label each requirement, using a convention robust enough to withstand additions, deletions, and moves over time.", what does "robust" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: robust /rəʊˈbʌst/ (tính từ): vững chắc, bền vững. "Robust enough to…" = đủ vững để…; trong phần mềm "robust" = chịu được lỗi và thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: robust /rəʊˈbʌst/ (adjective): strong, not easily broken. "Robust enough to…" means strong enough to cope; in software it means handling errors and change well.

items.question: Trong câu "Uniquely label each requirement, using a convention robust enough to withstand additions, deletions, and moves over time.", từ "withstand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Uniquely label each requirement, using a convention robust enough to withstand additions, deletions, and moves over time.", what does "withstand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: withstand /wɪðˈstænd/ (động từ): chịu được, trụ vững. "Withstand pressure/change" = chịu được áp lực/thay đổi mà không hỏng.
items.explanationEn: withstand /wɪðˈstænd/ (verb): to endure without failing. "Withstand pressure/change" means enduring it without breaking.

items.question: Trong câu "Peer review — particularly inspection — is one of the highest-value software quality practices available.", từ "inspection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Peer review — particularly inspection — is one of the highest-value software quality practices available.", what does "inspection" (noun) mean?
options: sự thẩm tra kỹ (có quy trình)
items.explanation: inspection /ɪnˈspek.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự thẩm tra kỹ (có quy trình). Trong kỹ nghệ phần mềm, "inspection" là hình thức review chính thức, có vai trò và checklist rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: inspection /ɪnˈspek.ʃən/ (noun): a formal, careful examination. In software engineering an "inspection" is the most formal type of peer review, with defined roles.

items.question: Trong câu "Commercial tools let BAs build executable mock-ups users can interact with, making requirements come to life before they are cast into the concrete of code.", từ "mock-up" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Commercial tools let BAs build executable mock-ups users can interact with, making requirements come to life before they are cast into the concrete of code.", what does "mock-up" (noun) mean?
options: bản mô phỏng, bản dựng thử
optionsEn: a model for trying out a design
items.explanation: mock-up /ˈmɒk.ʌp/ (danh từ): bản mô phỏng, bản dựng thử. "Build a mock-up" = dựng bản mô phỏng giao diện/chức năng để người dùng thử trước khi code thật.
items.explanationEn: mock-up /ˈmɒk.ʌp/ (noun): a model for trying out a design. "Build a mock-up" means creating a model of a design so users can try it before real coding.

items.question: Trong câu "Commercial tools let BAs build executable mock-ups users can interact with, making requirements come to life before they are cast into the concrete of code.", từ "come to life" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Commercial tools let BAs build executable mock-ups users can interact with, making requirements come to life before they are cast into the concrete of code.", what does "come to life" (phrase) mean?
options: trở nên sống động, hiện hữu
items.explanation: come to life /kʌm tə laɪf/ (cụm từ): trở nên sống động, hiện hữu. "Make something come to life" = làm cho điều gì đó trở nên sống động, dễ hình dung.
items.explanationEn: come to life /kʌm tə laɪf/ (phrase): to become vivid and real. "Make something come to life" means making it vivid and easy to picture.

items.question: Trong câu "Once you have the initial requirements, you must cope with the inevitable changes from customers, management, marketing, and the development team.", từ "cope with" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Once you have the initial requirements, you must cope with the inevitable changes from customers, management, marketing, and the development team.", what does "cope with" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: cope with /kəʊp wɪð/ (cụm từ): đối phó, xử lý. "Cope with change/pressure" = xoay xở, xử lý được thay đổi hay áp lực.
items.explanationEn: cope with /kəʊp wɪð/ (phrase): to deal with. "Cope with change/pressure" means managing it successfully.

items.question: Trong câu "Once you have the initial requirements, you must cope with the inevitable changes from customers, management, marketing, and the development team.", từ "inevitable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Once you have the initial requirements, you must cope with the inevitable changes from customers, management, marketing, and the development team.", what does "inevitable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inevitable /ɪˈnev.ɪ.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể tránh khỏi. "Inevitable changes" = những thay đổi chắc chắn xảy ra; trạng từ: inevitably.
items.explanationEn: inevitable /ɪˈnev.ɪ.tə.bəl/ (adjective): certain to happen. "Inevitable changes" are changes that will certainly happen; adverb: inevitably.

items.question: Trong câu "Rather than stifling change or hoping it will not happen, provide a mechanism that prevents rampant change from causing chaos.", từ "stifle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rather than stifling change or hoping it will not happen, provide a mechanism that prevents rampant change from causing chaos.", what does "stifle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stifle /ˈstaɪ.fəl/ (động từ): kìm hãm, bóp nghẹt. "Stifle change/creativity" = kìm hãm sự thay đổi/sáng tạo; nghĩa đen là làm ngạt thở.
items.explanationEn: stifle /ˈstaɪ.fəl/ (verb): to suppress. "Stifle change/creativity" means suppressing it; the literal sense is to smother.

items.question: Trong câu "Rather than stifling change or hoping it will not happen, provide a mechanism that prevents rampant change from causing chaos.", từ "rampant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rather than stifling change or hoping it will not happen, provide a mechanism that prevents rampant change from causing chaos.", what does "rampant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rampant /ˈræm.pənt/ (tính từ): tràn lan, mất kiểm soát. "Rampant change" = thay đổi tràn lan không kiểm soát; hay gặp: "rampant inflation", "rampant corruption".
items.explanationEn: rampant /ˈræm.pənt/ (adjective): spreading out of control. "Rampant change" is change that spreads unchecked; compare "rampant inflation".

items.question: Trong câu "Give every version of the specification a unique identifier so drafts are never confused with baselines.", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Give every version of the specification a unique identifier so drafts are never confused with baselines.", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the back line of a court
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (danh từ): phiên bản gốc đã chốt. "Establish a baseline" = chốt một phiên bản làm mốc; mọi thay đổi sau đó phải qua kiểm soát thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (noun): an agreed reference version. "Establish a baseline" means agreeing a reference version; later changes go through change control.

items.question: Trong câu "Assign a single owner to each issue so nothing falls through the cracks.", từ "fall through the cracks" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assign a single owner to each issue so nothing falls through the cracks.", what does "fall through the cracks" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fall through the cracks /fɔːl θruː ðə kræks/ (cụm từ): bị bỏ sót, lọt lưới. "Fall through the cracks" = bị bỏ quên vì không ai chịu trách nhiệm theo dõi.
items.explanationEn: fall through the cracks /fɔːl θruː ðə kræks/ (phrase): to be overlooked. "Fall through the cracks" means being forgotten because nobody is responsible for it.

items.question: Trong câu "Maintain a requirements traceability matrix, populated during development rather than at the end.", từ "populate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Maintain a requirements traceability matrix, populated during development rather than at the end.", what does "populate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: populate /ˈpɒp.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): điền dữ liệu vào. "Populate a table/matrix" = điền dữ liệu vào bảng; nghĩa khác: cư ngụ (densely populated).
items.explanationEn: populate /ˈpɒp.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to fill with data. "Populate a table/matrix" means filling it with data; another sense is to inhabit (densely populated).

items.question: Trong câu "The most effective classes have an audience spanning multiple project functions, not just BAs.", từ "span" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most effective classes have an audience spanning multiple project functions, not just BAs.", what does "span" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: span /spæn/ (động từ): trải rộng, bao gồm. "Spanning multiple functions" = bao gồm người từ nhiều bộ phận; danh từ "span" = khoảng (time span).
items.explanationEn: span /spæn/ (verb): to extend across. "Spanning multiple functions" means covering several departments; the noun means a range (time span).

items.question: Trong câu "It doubles as a team-building activity.", từ "double as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It doubles as a team-building activity.", what does "double as" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to serve a second purpose as
items.explanation: double as /ˈdʌb.əl æz/ (cụm từ): kiêm luôn vai trò. "X doubles as Y" = X kiêm luôn chức năng Y (vd. a sofa that doubles as a bed).
items.explanationEn: double as /ˈdʌb.əl æz/ (phrase): to serve a second purpose as. "X doubles as Y" means X also serves as Y (e.g. a sofa that doubles as a bed).

items.question: Trong câu "Day-in-the-life experiences alongside users are a sound investment.", từ "sound" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Day-in-the-life experiences alongside users are a sound investment.", what does "sound" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sound /saʊnd/ (tính từ): đúng đắn, đáng tin cậy. "A sound investment/decision" = khoản đầu tư/quyết định đúng đắn; khác với danh từ "sound" (âm thanh).
items.explanationEn: sound /saʊnd/ (adjective): wise and reliable. "A sound investment/decision" is a wise one; unrelated to the noun "sound" (noise).

items.question: Trong câu "Create a glossary defining specialized terms, acronyms, and words with more than one meaning.", từ "acronym" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Create a glossary defining specialized terms, acronyms, and words with more than one meaning.", what does "acronym" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a word with the same meaning
items.explanation: acronym /ˈæk.rə.nɪm/ (danh từ): từ viết tắt. "Acronym" = từ viết tắt ghép từ chữ cái đầu (vd. CCB, JAD); nên đưa vào glossary.
items.explanationEn: acronym /ˈæk.rə.nɪm/ (noun): an abbreviation from initials. An "acronym" is built from initial letters (e.g. CCB, JAD); list them in the glossary.

items.question: Trong câu "Select an appropriate development life cycle for the degree of requirements uncertainty.", từ "uncertainty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Select an appropriate development life cycle for the degree of requirements uncertainty.", what does "uncertainty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (danh từ): sự không chắc chắn. "Degree of uncertainty" = mức độ chưa rõ ràng; yêu cầu càng mơ hồ càng hợp với vòng đời lặp.
items.explanationEn: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (noun): lack of certainty. "Degree of uncertainty" is how unclear things are; more uncertainty favours iterative life cycles.

items.question: Trong câu "Renegotiate commitments when requirements change.", từ "renegotiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Renegotiate commitments when requirements change.", what does "renegotiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: renegotiate /ˌriː.nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (động từ): đàm phán lại. "Renegotiate a contract/commitment" = thương lượng lại các điều khoản khi hoàn cảnh thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: renegotiate /ˌriː.nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (verb): to negotiate again. "Renegotiate a contract/commitment" means discussing new terms when circumstances change.

items.question: Trong câu "If the current commitments are no longer achievable with the available resources, communicate the reality and negotiate.", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the current commitments are no longer achievable with the available resources, communicate the reality and negotiate.", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (danh từ): cam kết (đã hứa). "Make/meet a commitment" = đưa ra/đáp ứng cam kết; nghĩa khác: sự tận tâm (commitment to quality).
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (noun): a promise to deliver. "Make/meet a commitment" is about promises; another sense is dedication (commitment to quality).

items.question: Trong câu "If the current commitments are no longer achievable with the available resources, communicate the reality and negotiate.", từ "achievable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the current commitments are no longer achievable with the available resources, communicate the reality and negotiate.", what does "achievable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: achievable /əˈtʃiː.və.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể đạt được. "Achievable goals" = mục tiêu khả thi; chữ A trong tiêu chí SMART là Achievable.
items.explanationEn: achievable /əˈtʃiː.və.bəl/ (adjective): possible to reach. "Achievable goals" are realistic; the A in SMART goals stands for Achievable.

items.question: Trong câu "Review lessons learned from earlier projects through retrospectives.", từ "retrospective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Review lessons learned from earlier projects through retrospectives.", what does "retrospective" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a meeting to reflect on past work
an art show of past works
items.explanation: retrospective /ˌret.rəˈspek.tɪv/ (danh từ): buổi họp rút kinh nghiệm. "Hold a retrospective" = tổ chức buổi nhìn lại xem điều gì tốt, điều gì cần cải thiện.
items.explanationEn: retrospective /ˌret.rəˈspek.tɪv/ (noun): a meeting to reflect on past work. "Hold a retrospective" means meeting to review what went well and what to improve.

items.question: Trong câu "How to choose: rank practices along two axes — value contributed and difficulty of implementation — and start with the high value, low difficulty group.", từ "axis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to choose: rank practices along two axes — value contributed and difficulty of implementation — and start with the high value, low difficulty group.", what does "axis" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the rod a wheel turns on
items.explanation: axis /ˈæk.sɪs/ (danh từ): trục (tiêu chí đánh giá). Số nhiều của "axis" là "axes" /ˈæk.siːz/; "along two axes" = theo hai tiêu chí.
items.explanationEn: axis /ˈæk.sɪs/ (noun): a dimension for comparison. The plural of "axis" is "axes" /ˈæk.siːz/; "along two axes" means on two dimensions.

items.question: Trong câu "Note this classification is not absolute — your experience may differ.", từ "absolute" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note this classification is not absolute — your experience may differ.", what does "absolute" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: absolute /ˈæb.sə.luːt/ (tính từ): tuyệt đối, cố định. "Not absolute" = không cố định, có thể khác tùy hoàn cảnh; trái nghĩa: relative (tương đối).
items.explanationEn: absolute /ˈæb.sə.luːt/ (adjective): fixed, true in every case. "Not absolute" means it can vary with circumstances; opposite: relative.

items.question: Trong câu "Some practices can be adopted mid-project (the change management group); others must wait for the next project or iteration (the elicitation group).", từ "adopt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some practices can be adopted mid-project (the change management group); others must wait for the next project or iteration (the elicitation group).", what does "adopt" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to legally take in a child
items.explanation: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (động từ): áp dụng. "Adopt a practice/approach" = bắt đầu áp dụng một cách làm; danh từ: adoption.
items.explanationEn: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (verb): to start using. "Adopt a practice/approach" means starting to use it; noun: adoption.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA is the principal interpreter through which requirements flow between the customer community and the development team.", từ "principal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA is the principal interpreter through which requirements flow between the customer community and the development team.", what does "principal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: principal /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (tính từ): chính, chủ yếu. "Principal" (tính từ) = chính yếu; danh từ "principal" = hiệu trưởng. Đừng nhầm với "principle" (nguyên tắc).
items.explanationEn: principal /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (adjective): main, most important. "Principal" as an adjective means main; as a noun, head of a school. Do not confuse with "principle".

items.question: Trong câu "The BA is the principal interpreter through which requirements flow between the customer community and the development team.", từ "interpreter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA is the principal interpreter through which requirements flow between the customer community and the development team.", what does "interpreter" (noun) mean?
options: người diễn giải, chuyển tải ý
items.explanation: interpreter /ɪnˈtɜː.prɪ.tər/ (danh từ): người diễn giải, chuyển tải ý. Nghĩa gốc: phiên dịch viên; BA "phiên dịch" nhu cầu kinh doanh sang ngôn ngữ kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: interpreter /ɪnˈtɜː.prɪ.tər/ (noun): a person who conveys meaning. The core sense is a translator; the BA translates business needs into technical terms.

items.question: Trong câu "Synonyms include requirements analyst, systems analyst, requirements engineer, requirements manager, application analyst, business systems analyst, IT business analyst, or simply analyst.", từ "synonym" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Synonyms include requirements analyst, systems analyst, requirements engineer, requirements manager, application analyst, business systems analyst, IT business analyst, or simply analyst.", what does "synonym" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a word with the same meaning
a word with the opposite meaning
items.explanation: synonym /ˈsɪn.ə.nɪm/ (danh từ): từ đồng nghĩa. Tính từ "synonymous with" = đồng nghĩa với; trái nghĩa của synonym là antonym.
items.explanationEn: synonym /ˈsɪn.ə.nɪm/ (noun): a word with the same meaning. Adjective: "synonymous with"; the opposite of synonym is antonym.

items.question: Trong câu "Crucially, when someone performing another project role also serves as BA, they are doing two distinct jobs.", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Crucially, when someone performing another project role also serves as BA, they are doing two distinct jobs.", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): riêng biệt, khác nhau. "Two distinct jobs" = hai công việc tách biệt; nghĩa khác: rõ rệt (a distinct smell).
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): separate, different. "Two distinct jobs" are separate ones; another sense is clearly noticeable (a distinct smell).

items.question: Trong câu "Crucially, when someone performing another project role also serves as BA, they are doing two distinct jobs.", từ "crucially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Crucially, when someone performing another project role also serves as BA, they are doing two distinct jobs.", what does "crucially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: crucially /ˈkruː.ʃəl.i/ (trạng từ): điều quan trọng là. Đứng đầu câu để nhấn mạnh ý then chốt; tính từ: crucial (cốt yếu).
items.explanationEn: crucially /ˈkruː.ʃəl.i/ (adverb): most importantly. Used at the start of a sentence to flag the key point; adjective: crucial.

items.question: Trong câu "One company found it could inspect specifications written by experienced analysts twice as fast as those from novices, because they contained fewer defects.", từ "novice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One company found it could inspect specifications written by experienced analysts twice as fast as those from novices, because they contained fewer defects.", what does "novice" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: novice /ˈnɒv.ɪs/ (danh từ): người mới vào nghề. "Novice" đối lập với "expert/experienced"; từ gần nghĩa: beginner, newcomer.
items.explanationEn: novice /ˈnɒv.ɪs/ (noun): a beginner. "Novice" is the opposite of "expert"; similar words: beginner, newcomer.

items.question: Trong câu "One company found it could inspect specifications written by experienced analysts twice as fast as those from novices, because they contained fewer defects.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One company found it could inspect specifications written by experienced analysts twice as fast as those from novices, because they contained fewer defects.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. "Defect" (danh từ) = lỗi; động từ "defect" /dɪˈfekt/ lại nghĩa là bỏ sang phe khác.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a fault or flaw. As a noun, "defect" is a flaw; the verb /dɪˈfekt/ means to desert to another side.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not assume that any talented developer or knowledgeable user can automatically be an effective business analyst without training, resource materials, and coaching.", từ "knowledgeable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not assume that any talented developer or knowledgeable user can automatically be an effective business analyst without training, resource materials, and coaching.", what does "knowledgeable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: knowledgeable /ˈnɒl.ɪ.dʒə.bəl/ (tính từ): hiểu biết nhiều. "Knowledgeable about something" = am hiểu về điều gì. Chú ý phát âm /ˈnɒl/.
items.explanationEn: knowledgeable /ˈnɒl.ɪ.dʒə.bəl/ (adjective): well-informed. "Knowledgeable about something" means knowing a lot about it. Note the pronunciation /ˈnɒl/.

items.question: Trong câu "Work with the funding sponsor, product manager, or marketing manager to express the vision clearly, usually via a vision and scope document.", từ "sponsor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Work with the funding sponsor, product manager, or marketing manager to express the vision clearly, usually via a vision and scope document.", what does "sponsor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who funds a project
items.explanation: sponsor /ˈspɒn.sər/ (danh từ): nhà tài trợ (dự án). "Project sponsor" = người cấp vốn và bảo trợ dự án; nghĩa khác: người bảo lãnh.
items.explanationEn: sponsor /ˈspɒn.sər/ (noun): a person who funds a project. "Project sponsor" is the person who funds and backs a project; another sense is a guarantor.

items.question: Trong câu "Select appropriate representatives for each user class, enlist their participation, and negotiate their responsibilities.", từ "enlist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Select appropriate representatives for each user class, enlist their participation, and negotiate their responsibilities.", what does "enlist" (verb) mean?
options: tranh thủ, vận động (sự tham gia)
items.explanation: enlist /ɪnˈlɪst/ (động từ): tranh thủ, vận động (sự tham gia). "Enlist someone’s help/support" = vận động được sự giúp đỡ của ai; nghĩa gốc: nhập ngũ.
items.explanationEn: enlist /ɪnˈlɪst/ (verb): to secure someone’s help. "Enlist someone’s help/support" means getting them involved; the original sense is joining the army.

items.question: Trong câu "A proactive BA helps users articulate the capabilities they need, rather than transcribing passively.", từ "articulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A proactive BA helps users articulate the capabilities they need, rather than transcribing passively.", what does "articulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: articulate /ɑːˈtɪk.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): diễn đạt rõ ràng. "Articulate needs/ideas" = diễn đạt nhu cầu/ý tưởng rõ ràng; tính từ "articulate" /-lət/ = ăn nói lưu loát.
items.explanationEn: articulate /ɑːˈtɪk.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to express clearly in words. "Articulate needs/ideas" means expressing them clearly; the adjective /-lət/ means well-spoken.

items.question: Trong câu "A proactive BA helps users articulate the capabilities they need, rather than transcribing passively.", từ "proactive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A proactive BA helps users articulate the capabilities they need, rather than transcribing passively.", what does "proactive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: proactive /prəʊˈæk.tɪv/ (tính từ): chủ động. "Proactive" = chủ động hành động trước; đối lập với "reactive" (chỉ phản ứng khi có chuyện).
items.explanationEn: proactive /prəʊˈæk.tɪv/ (adjective): taking initiative. "Proactive" means acting ahead; the opposite is "reactive" (responding only after events).

items.question: Trong câu "Look for derived requirements (logical consequences of what customers asked for) and implicit requirements (things customers expect without saying so).", từ "implicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Look for derived requirements (logical consequences of what customers asked for) and implicit requirements (things customers expect without saying so).", what does "implicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: implicit /ɪmˈplɪs.ɪt/ (tính từ): ngầm hiểu, không nói ra. "Implicit requirements" = yêu cầu ngầm; trái nghĩa: explicit (tường minh).
items.explanationEn: implicit /ɪmˈplɪs.ɪt/ (adjective): implied without being stated. "Implicit requirements" are implied but unstated; opposite: explicit.

items.question: Trong câu "Look for derived requirements (logical consequences of what customers asked for) and implicit requirements (things customers expect without saying so).", từ "derived" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Look for derived requirements (logical consequences of what customers asked for) and implicit requirements (things customers expect without saying so).", what does "derived" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: derived /dɪˈraɪvd/ (tính từ): được suy ra (từ cái khác). Động từ "derive from" = bắt nguồn/suy ra từ; "derived requirements" là hệ quả logic của yêu cầu gốc.
items.explanationEn: derived /dɪˈraɪvd/ (adjective): worked out from something else. Verb: "derive from"; "derived requirements" follow logically from the original requests.

items.question: Trong câu "Not putting requirements on paper and tossing them over a wall, but ongoing collaboration to ensure the team understands.", từ "ongoing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not putting requirements on paper and tossing them over a wall, but ongoing collaboration to ensure the team understands.", what does "ongoing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ongoing /ˈɒŋ.ɡəʊ.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): liên tục, đang diễn ra. "Ongoing collaboration/support" = hợp tác/hỗ trợ liên tục, không phải một lần là xong.
items.explanationEn: ongoing /ˈɒŋ.ɡəʊ.ɪŋ/ (adjective): continuing. "Ongoing collaboration/support" continues over time rather than happening once.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA brokers collaboration and negotiation among stakeholders and developers.", từ "broker" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA brokers collaboration and negotiation among stakeholders and developers.", what does "broker" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: broker /ˈbrəʊ.kər/ (động từ): làm trung gian dàn xếp. "Broker a deal/agreement" = đứng giữa dàn xếp thỏa thuận; danh từ "broker" = người môi giới.
items.explanationEn: broker /ˈbrəʊ.kər/ (verb): to arrange as a go-between. "Broker a deal/agreement" means arranging it between parties; the noun means an agent or middleman.

items.question: Trong câu "Patience and a genuine desire to work with people are key success factors.", từ "genuine" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Patience and a genuine desire to work with people are key success factors.", what does "genuine" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (tính từ): thật lòng, chân thành. "A genuine desire/interest" = mong muốn/quan tâm thật lòng; nghĩa khác: hàng thật (genuine leather).
items.explanationEn: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (adjective): sincere, real. "A genuine desire/interest" is sincere; another sense is authentic (genuine leather).

items.question: Trong câu "You must grasp what is said and read between the lines for what people hesitate to say.", từ "read between the lines" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You must grasp what is said and read between the lines for what people hesitate to say.", what does "read between the lines" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: read between the lines /riːd bɪˈtwiːn ðə laɪnz/ (cụm từ): hiểu ý ngầm. "Read between the lines" = nhận ra điều người khác ngụ ý mà không nói thẳng.
items.explanationEn: read between the lines /riːd bɪˈtwiːn ðə laɪnz/ (phrase): to grasp the hidden meaning. "Read between the lines" means noticing what someone implies but does not say.

items.question: Trong câu "You must grasp what is said and read between the lines for what people hesitate to say.", từ "hesitate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You must grasp what is said and read between the lines for what people hesitate to say.", what does "hesitate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hesitate /ˈhez.ɪ.teɪt/ (động từ): ngần ngại, do dự. "Hesitate to do something" = ngần ngại làm gì; "Don’t hesitate to ask" = cứ hỏi đừng ngại.
items.explanationEn: hesitate /ˈhez.ɪ.teɪt/ (verb): to be reluctant, to pause. "Hesitate to do something" means being reluctant; "Don’t hesitate to ask" invites questions.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA must probe for error conditions.", từ "probe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA must probe for error conditions.", what does "probe" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: probe /prəʊb/ (động từ): thăm dò, tìm hiểu sâu. "Probe for details/errors" = hỏi sâu để tìm chi tiết/lỗi; danh từ "probe" = đầu dò, cuộc điều tra.
items.explanationEn: probe /prəʊb/ (verb): to investigate deeply. "Probe for details/errors" means questioning deeply; the noun is a sensor or an investigation.

items.question: Trong câu "Think at both high and low levels of abstraction, and know when to move between them.", từ "abstraction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Think at both high and low levels of abstraction, and know when to move between them.", what does "abstraction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: abstraction /æbˈstræk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự trừu tượng hóa. "Levels of abstraction" = mức độ khái quát: cao là bức tranh tổng thể, thấp là chi tiết cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: abstraction /æbˈstræk.ʃən/ (noun): focusing on essentials, not detail. "Levels of abstraction" range from the big picture (high) to concrete detail (low).

items.question: Trong câu "You need not be a domain expert, but you must never hide your ignorance.", từ "ignorance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need not be a domain expert, but you must never hide your ignorance.", what does "ignorance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ignorance /ˈɪɡ.nər.əns/ (danh từ): sự thiếu hiểu biết. "Hide your ignorance" = giấu việc mình không biết; tính từ: ignorant. Lưu ý khác với "ignore" (phớt lờ).
items.explanationEn: ignorance /ˈɪɡ.nər.əns/ (noun): lack of knowledge. "Hide your ignorance" means concealing what you do not know; adjective: ignorant (not "ignore").

items.question: Trong câu "Create a collaborative environment and foster trust among stakeholder groups that do not understand each other motivations and constraints.", từ "foster" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Create a collaborative environment and foster trust among stakeholder groups that do not understand each other motivations and constraints.", what does "foster" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: foster /ˈfɒs.tər/ (động từ): nuôi dưỡng, thúc đẩy. "Foster trust/collaboration" = vun đắp lòng tin/sự hợp tác; nghĩa khác: nhận nuôi (foster parents).
items.explanationEn: foster /ˈfɒs.tər/ (verb): to encourage the growth of. "Foster trust/collaboration" means helping it grow; another sense is to raise a child (foster parents).

items.question: Trong câu "Catch comments made in passing and subtleties users would never think to mention.", từ "in passing" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Catch comments made in passing and subtleties users would never think to mention.", what does "in passing" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in passing /ɪn ˈpɑː.sɪŋ/ (cụm từ): tiện thể, thoáng qua. "Mention something in passing" = nhắc qua loa, tiện miệng; thường chứa thông tin quý cho BA.
items.explanationEn: in passing /ɪn ˈpɑː.sɪŋ/ (phrase): briefly, casually. "Mention something in passing" means saying it casually, often revealing valuable details.

items.question: Trong câu "Catch comments made in passing and subtleties users would never think to mention.", từ "subtlety" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Catch comments made in passing and subtleties users would never think to mention.", what does "subtlety" (noun) mean?
options: chi tiết tinh tế, khó thấy
items.explanation: subtlety /ˈsʌt.əl.ti/ (danh từ): chi tiết tinh tế, khó thấy. Tính từ "subtle" /ˈsʌt.əl/ (chữ b câm); "subtleties" = những điểm tinh tế dễ bỏ qua.
items.explanationEn: subtlety /ˈsʌt.əl.ti/ (noun): a fine, easily missed detail. Adjective: "subtle" /ˈsʌt.əl/ (silent b); "subtleties" are fine points easily missed.

items.question: Trong câu "Cope with a jumble of rapidly changing information and set up an information architecture for the project.", từ "jumble" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cope with a jumble of rapidly changing information and set up an information architecture for the project.", what does "jumble" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: jumble /ˈdʒʌm.bəl/ (danh từ): mớ hỗn độn. "A jumble of information" = một mớ thông tin lộn xộn; động từ "jumble up" = làm rối tung.
items.explanationEn: jumble /ˈdʒʌm.bəl/ (noun): a messy mixture. "A jumble of information" is a disorganised mass; verb: "jumble up".

items.question: Trong câu "One caveat on creativity: the BA must avoid gold-plating the solution — do not simply add new requirements to the specification without customer approval.", từ "caveat" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One caveat on creativity: the BA must avoid gold-plating the solution — do not simply add new requirements to the specification without customer approval.", what does "caveat" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: caveat /ˈkæv.i.æt/ (danh từ): lời lưu ý, cảnh báo. "One caveat" = một lưu ý kèm theo; hay gặp trong tài liệu kỹ thuật: "Caveat: ..."
items.explanationEn: caveat /ˈkæv.i.æt/ (noun): a warning or condition. "One caveat" is a warning attached to advice; common in technical docs as "Caveat: ...".

items.question: Trong câu "One caveat on creativity: the BA must avoid gold-plating the solution — do not simply add new requirements to the specification without customer approval.", từ "gold-plating" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One caveat on creativity: the BA must avoid gold-plating the solution — do not simply add new requirements to the specification without customer approval.", what does "gold-plating" (noun) mean?
options: mạ một lớp vàng lên đồ trang sức
tối ưu hiệu năng cho toàn hệ thống
thêm tính năng thừa không ai yêu cầu
kiểm thử kỹ lưỡng mọi chức năng
optionsEn: coating jewellery with a gold layer
tuning the whole system for speed
items.explanation: gold-plating /ˌɡəʊld ˈpleɪ.tɪŋ/ (danh từ): thêm tính năng thừa không ai yêu cầu. Trong quản lý dự án, "gold-plating" = tự ý thêm tính năng ngoài yêu cầu, gây tốn công và rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: gold-plating /ˌɡəʊld ˈpleɪ.tɪŋ/ (noun): adding features nobody asked for. In project management, "gold-plating" means adding unrequested extras that cost effort and add risk.

items.question: Trong câu "An author once asked a colleague for a script to intercept and parse information out of email messages.", từ "intercept" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An author once asked a colleague for a script to intercept and parse information out of email messages.", what does "intercept" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: intercept /ˌɪn.təˈsept/ (động từ): chặn bắt, chặn lấy. "Intercept messages/requests" = chặn lại giữa đường để xử lý (vd. HTTP interceptor).
items.explanationEn: intercept /ˌɪn.təˈsept/ (verb): to catch on the way. "Intercept messages/requests" means catching them in transit (e.g. an HTTP interceptor).

items.question: Trong câu "When you step back to the underlying issue, you almost always find multiple ways to solve the problem, some of them better than the first one that popped into your head.", từ "underlying" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you step back to the underlying issue, you almost always find multiple ways to solve the problem, some of them better than the first one that popped into your head.", what does "underlying" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: underlying /ˌʌn.dəˈlaɪ.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): cơ bản, ẩn bên dưới. "The underlying issue/cause" = vấn đề/nguyên nhân gốc rễ ẩn sau biểu hiện bên ngoài.
items.explanationEn: underlying /ˌʌn.dəˈlaɪ.ɪŋ/ (adjective): basic but not obvious. "The underlying issue/cause" is the real root behind the visible symptom.

items.question: Trong câu "BAs are grown from diverse backgrounds, each with its own strengths and blind spots:", từ "blind spot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs are grown from diverse backgrounds, each with its own strengths and blind spots:", what does "blind spot" (noun) mean?
options: điểm mù (hạn chế không tự thấy)
optionsEn: a weakness you fail to notice
an area a driver cannot see
items.explanation: blind spot /ˈblaɪnd spɒt/ (danh từ): điểm mù (hạn chế không tự thấy). Nghĩa bóng: điều mình không nhận ra ở bản thân; nghĩa đen: vùng khuất tầm nhìn khi lái xe.
items.explanationEn: blind spot /ˈblaɪnd spɒt/ (noun): a weakness you fail to notice. Figuratively, something you fail to see about yourself; literally, an area a driver cannot see.

items.question: Trong câu "Lacks experience and knowledge; needs mentoring to instil good habits from the outset", từ "from the outset" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lacks experience and knowledge; needs mentoring to instil good habits from the outset", what does "from the outset" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: from the outset /frəm ði ˈaʊt.set/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "From the outset" = ngay từ lúc bắt đầu; đồng nghĩa: from the start, from the beginning.
items.explanationEn: from the outset /frəm ði ˈaʊt.set/ (phrase): from the very start. "From the outset" means from the very beginning; synonyms: from the start.

items.question: Trong câu "Define a lightweight, flexible requirements process and adapt it as the project warrants.", từ "warrant" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define a lightweight, flexible requirements process and adapt it as the project warrants.", what does "warrant" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: warrant /ˈwɒr.ənt/ (động từ): đòi hỏi, biện minh cho. "As the situation warrants" = khi tình huống đòi hỏi; danh từ "warrant" = lệnh (search warrant).
items.explanationEn: warrant /ˈwɒr.ənt/ (verb): to call for, to justify. "As the situation warrants" means as it calls for; the noun is an official order (search warrant).

items.question: Trong câu "Neither extreme (specifying everything to the nth degree, or having no documentation at all) is ideal.", từ "to the nth degree" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Neither extreme (specifying everything to the nth degree, or having no documentation at all) is ideal.", what does "to the nth degree" (phrase) mean?
options: đến mức tối đa, cực kỳ chi tiết
items.explanation: to the nth degree /tə ðə enθ dɪˈɡriː/ (cụm từ): đến mức tối đa, cực kỳ chi tiết. "To the nth degree" = làm đến mức cực độ; ở đây là đặc tả chi tiết quá mức cần thiết.
items.explanationEn: to the nth degree /tə ðə enθ dɪˈɡriː/ (phrase): to the utmost extent. "To the nth degree" means to the extreme; here, specifying far more detail than needed.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements development is iterative, driven by progressive refinement of detail; the four activities interleave rather than follow one another.", từ "interleave" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements development is iterative, driven by progressive refinement of detail; the four activities interleave rather than follow one another.", what does "interleave" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: interleave /ˌɪn.təˈliːv/ (động từ): xen kẽ nhau. "Interleave" = đan xen, xen kẽ; gần nghĩa với "interweave" ở phần đầu bài.
items.explanationEn: interleave /ˌɪn.təˈliːv/ (verb): to alternate and mix. "Interleave" means to alternate and mix; close in meaning to "interweave".

items.question: Trong câu "Effort distribution differs by life cycle: waterfall front-loads it, iterative spreads it per cycle, agile spreads it into many small efforts.", từ "front-load" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Effort distribution differs by life cycle: waterfall front-loads it, iterative spreads it per cycle, agile spreads it into many small efforts.", what does "front-load" (verb) mean?
options: dồn phần lớn vào giai đoạn đầu
cắt giảm ở giai đoạn đầu
items.explanation: front-load /ˌfrʌnt ˈləʊd/ (động từ): dồn phần lớn vào giai đoạn đầu. "Front-load the effort" = dồn công sức vào đầu dự án, như mô hình waterfall.
items.explanationEn: front-load /ˌfrʌnt ˈləʊd/ (verb): to concentrate at the start. "Front-load the effort" means putting most of it at the beginning, as waterfall does.

items.question: Trong câu "On agile projects the BA tasks remain; a product owner usually absorbs some of them but rarely all.", từ "absorb" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On agile projects the BA tasks remain; a product owner usually absorbs some of them but rarely all.", what does "absorb" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take on as part of one’s own
items.explanation: absorb /əbˈzɔːb/ (động từ): đảm nhận, gánh lấy. "Absorb tasks/costs" = gánh luôn nhiệm vụ/chi phí; nghĩa đen: thấm hút.
items.explanationEn: absorb /əbˈzɔːb/ (verb): to take on as part of one’s own. "Absorb tasks/costs" means taking them on; the literal sense is to soak up.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA is the communication bridge between customers and the development team, and the person who forges that partnership.", từ "forge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA is the communication bridge between customers and the development team, and the person who forges that partnership.", what does "forge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: forge /fɔːdʒ/ (động từ): xây dựng, gây dựng (quan hệ). "Forge a partnership/relationship" = gây dựng quan hệ đối tác; nghĩa khác: rèn kim loại, giả mạo.
items.explanationEn: forge /fɔːdʒ/ (verb): to build a relationship. "Forge a partnership/relationship" means building it; other senses are shaping metal and faking.

items.question: Trong câu "Every career path into business analysis carries its own blind spots — identify yours and close the gaps deliberately.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every career path into business analysis carries its own blind spots — identify yours and close the gaps deliberately.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): một cách có chủ đích. "Deliberately" = có chủ ý, có kế hoạch; tính từ: deliberate.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose, intentionally. "Deliberately" means on purpose and with planning; adjective: deliberate.
